correctness.rationale: Explicit LCF graph is cubic with 18 edges. The standalone script exhaustively enumerates 1091 matching faces and 539 acyclic Morse pairs (3942 Hasse covering incidences); exactly one vertex and 12 three-cells remain, yielding an integral wedge of twelve S3. It independently enumerates the entire 48-element automorphism group, uses two distinct signed fixed-face/orbit formulas agreeing for each element, computes all 10 conjugacy classes, and checks an explicit complement H≅S4 via its faithful conjugation action on four order-three subgroups. Direct S4 character-table comparisons give the stated decomposition. A second independently implemented mod-two boundary verifier corroborates the homology dimensions. Only the claimed rational representation is newly asserted; the nonequivariant premise is known.

value.rationale: The Franklin graph is a classical Klein-bottle-related cubic graph whose integral matching homotopy type and edge deletion/link structure are known. Its 48-element symmetry action is not determined by that nonequivariant topology. The complete ten-class rational character, central half-turn 8-plus/4-minus dimensions, five irreducible constituents, and absence of global invariants form a canonical, nontrivial equivariant refinement with direct interpretability under the graph automorphisms. The contribution is an exact finite symmetry invariant; no artificial family or unsupported general theorem is claimed.
